QUOTE: On an installation without the bash and cmake grammars, shell and CMake fall back to file-set entries with no symbols and nothing raises. My reading of the code says the not-indexed report then fails to name those files, which contradicts the docs.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says installs without grammars degrade without raising, but it does not say a capability gate is consulted before routing, and it claims the not-indexed report does not list those files. That contradicts the item's "reported as not indexed".
